source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Using the build approach, I have now produced a framework for a website provisioning wizard; the attached skeleton page works quite well and also supports portrait mode. Claude needs guidance on these styling points:

* Type scale — confirm sizes, weights, line-heights, and tracking. The heading and body values are estimates for now, while fonts use system fallbacks until the Alan Sans and Plus Jakarta Sans .woff2 files arrive.
* Active-node accent — choosing between Signal purple and Pulse green remains the one unresolved design decision.
* Derived values — either confirm or replace the canvas surface colour (--surface), muted text tone (--text-muted), soft hairline (--line-soft), and node glow.
* Wizard placeholders — specify --page-x for percentage-based page margins, --wizard-panel-w at 720px, --wiz-node-size, and the portrait and landscape gaps.
* Button states — Back and Next still lack hover and active styling because the states sheet has not arrived. Until the final chevron asset is available, my current chevron remains a stand-in SVG.

None of this is blocking me, as I will continue implementing the actual steps and platform interaction in the meantime.
